_comment: Single config point for the lesson watch-gate's transcribe/review backends (Phase 2 of LESSON-GEN-V2-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN). Adding a new backend = adding a row here, zero code change. gemini-watch.py reads this via --provider <id>. kind: 'multimodal' = watches video + listens in one pass (gemini-watch can drive it); 'transcribe' = audio→text only, used for the transcript leg of the Phase-3 production gate (Gemini/Groq = sensor; Claude = judge). keyEnv is a prioritized list; the first env var that is set wins. Secrets live in the environment / 1Password, never here.

providers.notes: Dev default. Project 'voice/video' Gemini key. Native multimodal (frames + audio in one pass). Free tier.
Same capability as gemini-voice; separate project quota (the chatbot key).
Transcript leg only (no video). Not yet wired; GROQ_API_KEY not set. For the Phase-3 production gate's transcript step.
Fallback transcript provider. Transcript leg only.
